neighbours.label: the relative pronoun 'that' opening a clause about a noun (activities that, settings that, models that), as against the same noun followed by a preposition or a full stop
fire: The museum offers workshops that teach children about fossils.
We tested several methods that measure soil moisture accurately.
Teachers prefer textbooks that include plenty of exercises.
The city built parks that give families a place to relax.
Researchers designed tasks that resemble everyday decisions.
She collects old maps that show forgotten villages.
The company makes tools that help farmers plan their harvest.
Doctors recommend exercises that strengthen the lower back.
quiet: The museum offers workshops for children about fossils.
We tested several methods for measuring soil moisture.
Teachers prefer textbooks with plenty of exercises.
The city built parks for families to relax in.
Researchers designed tasks about everyday decisions.
She collects old maps of forgotten villages.
The company makes tools for farmers to plan their harvest.
Doctors recommend exercises for the lower back.
